**Finding: deviation (RENEWAL) — Article IV Term, paragraph p0049.**

The renewal mechanic gives Licensor a unilateral option to extend the licence for a further **seven years**, with no non-renewal right for us and no cap on renewal pricing. An automatic/optional multi-year renewal we cannot exit is walk-away territory under the rule, well short of even the fallback (≤60-day notice window, ≤5% uplift). It is also internally inconsistent with Article IV.II and IV.III, which say extensions are by mutual written agreement.

Redline (validated, preferred position): renewals become 12-month periods by mutual written agreement, with any renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
